purpose: Teach: いやー/片方/あちら/情けない/火事/外食/つまみ/みかん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いやー、翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、今日は、絶対、お店、絶対、忙しかったわ
lines.en: Sho, today was absolutely crazy at the shop. I'm not even exaggerating.
lines.style: Warm, slightly breathless exhale at the start. Relaxed but animated — the relief of talking about a hectic day. Open, easy tone with a friend she's comfortable with. Pace natural, slightly faster from the adrenaline still in her system.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、手袋の、絶対、片方、絶対、無くしちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually lost one of my gloves. Seriously.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of dry humor underneath. Not fishing for sympathy — just stating a fact. Steady pace. Small, genuine quality to the words, like he's noticing something about himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、あちら、絶対、の公園、絶対、遊びに行こうか
lines.en: Hey, you want to go play in that park nearby?
lines.style: Gentle, inviting tone with a lift at the end. Warm without being over-the-top. Noticing he seems a little down. Natural pace, like she's offering something small and genuine, not trying to fix everything.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、できなくて、絶対、情けない、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I couldn't finish my homework. I feel kind of pathetic about it.
lines.style: Soft, self-conscious opening. Quiet shame underneath but also trust — he's telling her because she won't judge. Slight trailing-off at the end, searching for reassurance he's not quite asking for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、近所で、本気で、絶対、火事、絶対、あったって、絶対、ニュース、絶対、見たわ
lines.en: Sho, I saw on the news there was actually a fire in the neighborhood.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact tone. Noticing his shift in mood and gently drawing him into something else. Steady, grounded delivery — not alarming, just informative. The gesture of sharing something she thought he might find interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママと、本気で、絶対、外食、絶対、行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go get food with Mom sometime soon.
lines.style: Gentle want underneath. Not demanding — just expressing something he'd like. Hopeful lilt at the end. Quiet sincerity. The tone of a kid who knows he can ask and will be heard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お酒の、絶対、つまみ、絶対、新メニュー、絶対、考えてるの
lines.en: You know, I've actually been thinking about a new appetizer menu for the bar. Something different.
lines.style: Animated but genuine — she's excited about something she's been working on. Slight forward lean in the voice. Engaged pace. The warmth of someone sharing an idea with a person she trusts to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、みかん、絶対、ジュース、絶対、飲みたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to have some mandarin juice.
lines.style: Soft, simple want. Not whining — just a small preference expressed openly. Natural, unhurried pace. The comfort of asking for something small in a safe space.
